PASSOS_NOVOS.EM_TESTE: This step is still being tested. You can set it up and run a test, but you can't save it yet.
PASSOS_NOVOS.ENSAIO_DE_EXEMPLO: Sample test run: this automation has a step that is still being tested. The conversations below are made up and nothing was really checked.
PASSOS_NOVOS.SEM_MODELO_FORA_DA_JANELA: If the 24-hour window is closed, nothing is sent and the automation stops in this conversation.

QUEM.NINGUEM: There is no one to choose here yet.

APROVACAO.DICA: Stops and waits for someone to approve or refuse before going on.
APROVACAO.PERGUNTA_PADRAO: Can I go ahead with this request?
APROVACAO.ENSAIO: Would ask {quem} for approval. In a test run, no one gets the request.
APROVACAO.QUEM_PODE: Only people who can see the card get the request. If no one answers in time, the automation takes the “If no one answers in time” path.

PEDIDO.SUBTITULO: This is how the request reaches the approver.
PEDIDO.APROVADO: You approved. The automation went on.
PEDIDO.RECUSADO: You refused. The automation took the refusal path.
PEDIDO.MOTIVO: Want to say why? It's optional.
PEDIDO.MOTIVO_EXEMPLO: For example: the discount is above what we agreed.

REPETIR.NOME: Do it for each one in a list
REPETIR.DICA: Repeats the steps for each card in a stage, each contact with a label or each contact in an audience.
REPETIR.DA_ETAPA_SEM_NOME: each card in the chosen stage
REPETIR.DA_ETIQUETA_SEM_NOME: each contact with the chosen label
REPETIR.DO_PUBLICO_SEM_NOME: each contact in the chosen audience
REPETIR.FRASE: For {lista}, up to {teto} at a time
REPETIR.ENSAIO: Today {total} would go in. The first ones: {nomes}.
REPETIR.ENSAIO_VAZIO: Choose the list to see how many would go in.
REPETIR.HISTORICO: Done for {feitos} of {total}. No one was left out.
REPETIR.ENTRARIAM_HOJE: would go in today | would go in today
REPETIR.PRIMEIROS: The first ones in the list
REPETIR.FICAM_FORA: Only people you can see go in. Blocked contacts and those who asked not to receive messages are left out.
REPETIR.TETO_DICA: From 1 to {maximo}. Anyone above that waits for the next time.
REPETIR.ONDE_POR_PASSOS: After saving, put the steps for each one in the “For each one in the list” path.

BLOCO.DICA: Uses a ready block and, when it ends, goes on from here.
BLOCO.ENSAIO: Would go into the block and: {passos}.
BLOCO.VAZIO: You don't have any blocks yet.
BLOCO.MUDA_EM_TODAS: If you change the block, it changes in every automation that uses it.

CONSULTAR.NOME: Look up information in another system
CONSULTAR.DICA: Looks up data outside, like an order status, and uses it in the next steps.
CONSULTAR.ENSAIO: Would look up in {fonte}. In a test run, it only looks up if you ask.
CONSULTAR.BUSCAR_DE_VERDADE: Really look up in this test run
CONSULTAR.CONFIRMAR_BUSCA: It will look up in {fonte} once, now. The result only shows here: nothing is saved and no one gets anything.
CONSULTAR.ENDERECO_DICA: Start with https://. Company internal addresses are not accepted.
CONSULTAR.ENDERECO_RUIM: The address must start with https://.
CONSULTAR.TESTAR_DICA: The test looks up once, only when you tap the button.
CONSULTAR.TOQUE_NO_DADO: Tap the data you want to keep
CONSULTAR.RESPOSTA_VAZIA: The test didn't bring any data.
CONSULTAR.NOME_DICA: It shows up with this name in “Add data” in the next steps.
CONSULTAR.FALTA_DADO: Run a test and tap at least one piece of data.
CONSULTAR.SE_FALHAR: If the other system fails or takes too long, the automation takes the “If it can't look it up” path.

REUNIAO.NOME: Book a meeting in the chat
REUNIAO.DICA: Offers 3 free times, the customer picks one and the meeting is booked.
REUNIAO.CONVITE_PADRAO: Hi! Can I call you at one of these times?
REUNIAO.FRASE: Offer 3 times in the calendar of {quem} and book the meeting
REUNIAO.ENSAIO: Would offer {horarios}. In a test run, nothing is sent.
REUNIAO.HISTORICO: The customer picked {horario}. The meeting was booked on the card.
REUNIAO.CONVITE: What to say before the times
REUNIAO.SEM_BOTOES: If the channel has no buttons, the numbers 1, 2 and 3 are sent.
REUNIAO.COMO_FUNCIONA: The AI understands the customer's answer. If no time works, the automation takes the “If they ask for another time” path.

PESQUISA.DICA: Asks for a score from 0 to 10 and takes a path for each score.
PESQUISA.PERGUNTA_PADRAO: From 0 to 10, what score would you give our service?
PESQUISA.ENSAIO: Would ask for the score and wait for the answer for {espera}. In a test run, nothing is sent.
PESQUISA.HISTORICO: Score 9: “Loved it, it just took a bit long”.
PESQUISA.BAIXA_ATE: The low score goes up to
PESQUISA.FAIXAS_RUINS: Leave at least one score for the medium score.
PESQUISA.INTERVALO: Ask the same person again only after
PESQUISA.RESUMO_EXEMPLO: In the list, the automation shows the average and how many people answered. Example: average 8.6 from 37 answers.
PESQUISA.REGRAS: Blocked contacts and those who asked not to receive messages are left out. The score is kept on the contact and on the card.

BOAS_VINDAS.FRASE: Welcomes the customer and asks if they have any questions.
BOAS_VINDAS.PASSO_3: Ask if they have any questions

LEMBRAR.FRASE: Tells whoever handles the card and waits for them.
LEMBRAR.PASSO_2: Wait until the card changes stage

DOCUMENTO.FRASE: Asks the customer for a document and reminds them once.
DOCUMENTO.PASSO_1: Ask the customer for the document
DOCUMENTO.PASSO_2: Remind after 2 days, if it doesn't arrive
